titleOptions: Two Long Boxes and the Birth of ComixCatalog
My Friend Gave Me 2 Long Boxes. They Broke My Website.
I Built Discogs for Comics. Then I Tried to Use It.

books.label: Prime #1 (1993), Malibu/Ultraverse example, not a confirmed box book

descriptionIntro: Two long boxes showed me what ComixCatalog could do. They also showed me exactly what it couldn't.
pinnedComment: What's the weirdest book in your long box? Tell me, especially if ComixCatalog can't find it yet.

shorts.title: How one collection became Discogs #discogs #comics #collecting
shorts.hook: Discogs started as one guy cataloging his own records.
shorts.description:
Discogs started in 2000 as one programmer's catalog of his own electronic music. Then other collectors showed up. Full episode on the channel: Two Long Boxes and the Birth of ComixCatalog.
